data.narrative:
Graphyte is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $57M to date, founded by Barclay Rogers. The valuation assessment draws on a universe of 9 comparable companies (1 public, 8 private) operating in the Climate & Energy sector, including peers such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy frontier-tech set; only one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers exist, with fewer than three meeting the filtering criteria for stage proximity and valuation tier alignment. Consequently, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $57M capital raised baseline implies a valuation of $114M.

The triangulated range stands at $97M (low) to $131M (high), with a median point of $114M. This range reflects a single applicable methodology and carries material uncertainty. Key dependencies include the appropriateness of the 2.0x multiplier for Graphyte's specific risk profile and market conditions, as well as the limited cross-sector comparability. Investors should treat this as a directional estimate pending either access to additional same-stage peers or proprietary diligence on unit economics and competitive positioning.
